research_mode: official ONS methodology sources only; CSEW estimation, quality assurance, interview controls, complex design and weighting; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: CSEW output measures
verified_claims: CSEW statistics are presented as incidence or prevalence rates
incident estimates are based on weighted counts
victim estimates are also weighted
limitations: incidence and prevalence answer different questions
weighted survey outputs are not direct local crime counts

sources.name: CSEW two-stage weighting design
verified_claims: raw data are first weighted for unequal selection probabilities
selection adjustment includes household size and oversampling effects
calibration weighting then adjusts for differential nonresponse
limitations: weighting reduces known design bias but does not remove all unobserved bias
weights are survey-edition specific

sources.name: Police-recorded-crime delivery assurance
verified_claims: the Home Office collects and validates police recorded crime data from forces
each quarterly delivery to ONS is accompanied by an agreed-template record of checks and QA procedures
the Home Office communicates corrections after delivery regardless of size
limitations: a delivery QA record is not record-level accuracy proof
post-delivery corrections require publication-version tracking

sources.name: Crime bulletin editorial responsibility
verified_claims: Home Office analysts with data expertise review the draft bulletin
their comments are considered by the production team
final editorial responsibility and responsible-statistician sign-off remain with ONS
limitations: expert review does not transfer editorial ownership
review does not independently audit every force record

sources.name: CSEW computer-assisted interviewing controls
verified_claims: CSEW adult interviews use computer-assisted personal interviewing
responses are recorded on interviewer tablets
logic and consistency checks can require discrepancies to be resolved before continuing
limitations: CAPI checks prevent defined inconsistencies rather than all response error
software rules require version control

sources.name: CSEW questionnaire architecture
verified_claims: the main questionnaire contains modules asked of the whole sample
other modules are asked only of subsamples
self-completion modules are also used
limitations: not every variable has the same base population
module routing must be retained in analysis metadata

sources.name: CSEW uncertainty calculation
verified_claims: variance calculations account for the complex sample design
the method incorporates covariance between household and personal crime
ONS user-guide tables provide 95 percent confidence intervals for relevant estimates
limitations: confidence intervals quantify sampling uncertainty rather than all measurement error
significance depends on the specified comparison

sources.name: CSEW design-weight components
verified_claims: w1 adjusts unequal address selection between police force areas
w2 adjusts observed address nonresponse variation
w3 and w4 adjust dwelling-unit and individual selection while numinc reflects incident-series counts
limitations: components apply to defined samples and outputs
weight names alone are insufficient without the edition formula

sources.name: CSEW calibration weighting controls
verified_claims: ONS calibration adjusts known response-rate differences
controls include age sex and region composition
weighted respondents are aligned to known population distributions
limitations: calibration cannot correct unknown differences within control groups
population controls and projections require edition metadata

sources.name: CSEW year-label semantics
verified_claims: before year ending March 2002 respondents reported the previous calendar year
older labels identify the year in which crime occurred
after continuous interviewing began labels identify the CSEW interview year covering the prior 12 months
limitations: year labels are not semantically constant across the series
attitude questions refer to interview-time views rather than the recall period
